principles: Knowledge layer is independent from GCMod/XUnity runtime outputs.
Canonical entities, surface references, terms, source entries, context groups, speech profiles, relationships, and guards are separate records.
Exact/context-aware matching is the default. Substring replacement is never implied by a term record.
category describes text usage; context_group describes texts that should be understood together.
status and confidence are independent axes.
R4 story evidence is migrated as reviewing/candidate unless an explicit user policy already approves a choice.
